messages:
jordan_customer: Hi, hitting a 400 on POST /v1/rerank. Quick repro attached. We only started seeing this after a client lib update.
alex_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the raw request body (no redaction) and the exact error message from the API? Also which SDK version? :eyes:
jordan_customer: Error is `400 Bad Request` with body `{"error":"invalid_request", "message":"request.items[0].id: expected string, got null"}`. SDK v2.3.4. Here's the request we sent:
```json
{
  "model": "rerank-large-001",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": null,
      "query": "How to reset password",
      "candidates": [
        {"id": "c1", "text": "Reset via settings"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "query": "Billing issue",
      "candidates": [
        {"id": "c2", "text": "Contact billing"}
      ]
      /* missing id on this item and also no per-item top_k */
    }
  ]
}
```
alex_support: Thanks — that helps. The spec requires each item to have a non-null `id` (string). Also we expect either a top_k at the item level or a global `top_k`. The SDK should validate this before sending; 2.3.4 had a bug around empty id serialization. Can you confirm whether you set a global top_k? If not, the server may be treating missing fields as invalid.
jordan_customer: We didn't include a global top_k, we assumed server default. Our code passes item.id = undefined in some cases which becomes null after JSON encoding.
sam_sre: @alex_support fyi — I searched logs for thread_ts:2101234567 and saw the API rejected the payload at the parsing stage, returned validation error 400. No runtime error on infra side. Rate limiting not involved.
lia_engineer: Quick repro curl so you can validate locally:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-large-001","items":[{"id":null,"query":"a","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"t"}]}]}'
```
lia_engineer: That will return the same 400. Short-term fix: ensure you never send null for `id`. Either set client-side guard or pass a string placeholder. Long-term: upgrade to SDK v2.3.5 which includes a validation hook and will throw before sending.
jordan_customer: OK trying the quick fix now — adding `item.id = item.id || "__no_id__"` — will report back.
jordan_customer: Patch worked, request accepted (200). Thanks. Any chance server could give a clearer message for missing top_k vs null id? The current error points at the null id but not the missing top_k when both are present.
alex_support: Good to hear. I'll file an internal request to improve validation error messages to include hints for `top_k`/defaults. For your team, recommend upgrading to v2.3.5 — it will prevent null ids and has safer defaults.
deploy-bot: Deployed SDK v2.3.5 to npm/npm-enterprise at 2101234600 :shipit:
alex_support: Closing this thread — reopen if it resurfaces after SDK upgrade. :white_check_mark:

jordan_customer: Thanks everyone!
